TC-22/S24.title: Retention edges: Hospital open tasks on a chart last processed 37 h ago are still shown (no open-task window on main)
TC-22/S24.detail: No model involved. Spec ext-tc22-s24-retention.spec.ts (re-run of the manual-lane spec): back-dated stamps written through rounding:add / snf:add, then applyLifecycle as on page load, against the server clock. Judged 7/8: Hospital completed tasks shown at 15 h and gone at 17 h (both charts), Hospital open tasks at 35 h shown, Nursing Home open tasks at 37 h and after two further visits shown; fails: Hospital open tasks on a chart processed 37 h ago still shown (UAT 3.6 open tasks 36 h) — known B19 (TFA-94699, in progress). Recorded (Q12): Nursing Home completed task at 15 h present, at 17 h gone.
TC-22/S24.productIssue: Hospital: open tasks on a chart nobody has processed for 37 h are still shown (UAT 3.6 says 36 h).
